title: Year 11 Chemistry Module 1 – Properties and Structure of Matter
description: A fast-recall review of NSW Year 11 Chemistry Module 1. Questions use short answers and avoid multi-step calculations or extended writing.
author: Generated with Classroom Jeopardy Quiz Maker

questions.prompt: What term describes matter made from only one type of substance?
What term describes two or more substances physically combined?
What separation method uses a barrier to separate an insoluble solid from a liquid?
What separation method uses differences in boiling point to separate liquids?
What type of mixture has a uniform composition throughout?
Which subatomic particle has a positive charge?
Which subatomic particle has no electric charge?
Which subatomic particle has a negative charge?
What number identifies an element by its number of protons?
What number equals the total number of protons and neutrons in an atom?
Which atomic model places electrons in fixed energy levels around the nucleus?
Which scientist’s scattering experiment provided evidence for a small, dense nucleus?
What are atoms of the same element with different numbers of neutrons called?
What term describes an unstable isotope that emits radiation?
Which atomic model describes electrons using orbitals rather than fixed circular paths?
questions.answer: The Schrödinger model. Accept: quantum mechanical model.

questions.prompt: What are the vertical columns of the periodic table called?
What are the horizontal rows of the periodic table called?
What generally happens to atomic radius from left to right across a period?
What generally happens to first ionisation energy from left to right across a period?
What property measures an atom’s attraction for bonding electrons?
What type of bond forms when electrons are transferred between atoms?
What type of bond forms when atoms share electrons?
What type of bonding involves positive metal ions surrounded by delocalised electrons?
What type of covalent structure is found in diamond?
questions.answer: A covalent network. Accept: network covalent structure.

questions.prompt: What term describes an unequal sharing of electrons in a covalent bond?
questions.answer: Bond polarity. Accept: a polar covalent bond.
